text:
mira_cs: Quick sync — Solarflare dedicated bring-up. Need to lock quota numbers, autoscale policy, and a short load test window before handoff to enablement. Renewal check: customer mentioned a Q4 SLA clause if p95 > 500ms.

sam_se: Got it. What's the committed capacity from their contract? GPUs / reserved qps?

mira_cs: Contract says 3 reserved nodes (4xA100 equivalent), soft target 30k tokens/min sustained. They want a 3-hour soak + 30m stress ramp.

jordan_sre: For that token rate we should plan for peak concurrent requests ~120 rps with avg seq len 100. I recommend autoscale min=3, max=6, surge threshold at 80% util.

kali_ae: Heads-up: renewal conversation starts next month. If we miss the p95 latency target during the live pilot, this customer flags for escalation. Please make the run deterministic.

mira_cs: Agreed. Action items: 1) SRE to provision autoscale policy + warm caches. 2) SE to run smoke + stress script and share metrics. 3) CS to capture customer feedback during soak.

jordan_sre: I'll create the autoscale policy and warm-up job. Policy draft: 
```
policy:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 6
  cpu_target: 70
  token_util_target: 0.8
  cooldown: 120s
```
I'll attach in the ticket.

sam_se: I'll run the load test tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Using k6 for load profile: 20m ramp to 120rps, 3h steady, 30m rampdown. Script logs to S3.

mira_cs: Please include these metrics in the run: p50/p95/p99 latency, error %, tokens/sec, token cost estimate. I'll prep the enablement checklist and recording.

kali_ae: Also capture any regen/fallbacks when we drop below node count. We need deterministic repro steps for renewal risk triage.

autoscale-bot: loadtest-schedule created (id: lt-2026-03-solarflare). Trigger: 2026-03-25T08:00:00Z.

jordan_sre: Warm cache plan: pre-populate KV for top 50 prompts, 10k prefix tokens, run 15m primer at 30rps before main soak. This should shave cold p95.

sam_se: Sample stress command I'll use for the generator: 
```
k6 run --vus 120 --duration 3h --out json=solarflare-stress.json stress_k6.js
```

mira_cs: Nice. I'll join the run and take notes on customer reactions. Please post the results to the thread (S3 link ok).

jordan_sre: After the run I'll do a quick fallback/drain test: remove 1 replica and watch fallback to compatible model variant + latency. If we see >2% errors or p95 > 600ms we stop and investigate.

sam_se: Understood. If all green I'll prepare a one-pager for the renewal team summarizing perf and mitigation.

kali_ae: ETA on results? Need to prep customer slides for their ops review on Friday.

sam_se: Running tomorrow, results posted within 2 hours after completion.

mira_cs: Great. Last note: capture qualitative feedback during the soak—any hallucination/regression signals, prompt-level regressions. I'll attach our eval checklist.

jordan_sre: Copy that. Will also attach scheduler logs and GPU telemetry (dcgm).

mira_cs: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the enablement invite and handoff doc once the metrics are in. :thumbsup:
